author: Linda Cook
title: Scott County Sheriff's Office sends 'thoughts and prayers' to injured state trooper - NewsBreak
text:
By Linda Cook ,
2 hours ago The Scott County Sheriff's Office extends thoughts and prayers to Trooper Carruthers with the Iowa State Patrol after a shooting on Tuesday, according to a Facebook post .
Carruthers was shot Tuesday afternoon in Stuart, Iowa, when he responded to gunfire. Responding officers found a deceased female when they arrived on the scene.
Carruthers was one of the first to arrive, and encountered a man - later identified as Austin Nichols Reed, 46 - who was armed with a shotgun. After Reed shot Carruthers, other officers took Reed into custody without further incident.
Trooper Chase Carruthers (Scott Count Sheriff's Office) Reed faces charges of first-degree murder and attempted murder of a police officer.
Carruthers was transported to a hospital, where he was listed in stable condition on Wednesday. Carruthers is a Rock Island native.
"Please keep him and the men and women of the Iowa Sate Patrol in your thoughts and prayers tonight," the release concludes.
